t1.RELEASE_NO: skip: one edition per table (history_releases 1); the edition number comes from the releases input
t1.RELEASE_DATE: key: newest edition — selects its rows
t1.ROW: key: row order — labels are found by text, not by row number
t1.C01: chart-ytd, chart-annual, kpi:ytd_serious, insight:ytd_serious — seriously injured (casualties block)
t1.C02: chart-season, chart-ytd, chart-annual, chart-severity, chart-revision, kpi:ytd_killed, kpi:ytd_chg, kpi:month_killed, kpi:year_killed, insight:ytd, insight:annual, insight:peak, insight:severity — killed
t1.C05: chart-trend, chart-annual, chart-severity, chart-revision, insight:severity, insight:revision — casualties, original data
t1.C07: chart-ytd, chart-annual, chart-severity, table:accidents — fatal accidents
t1.C10: chart-accidents, chart-ytd, chart-annual, chart-severity — accidents with casualties, original data
t1.C11: chart-season, chart-trend — roman month label (period rows)
t1.C12: chart-season, chart-annual — year label (period rows; '*' marks provisional years)
releases.TITLE: chart-revision — names the month each edition reports; the latest-edition card
releases.HEADLINE: chart-revision, insight:revision — first-reported counts for the month; the latest-edition card
releases.PAGE_URL: text: link to the release on cbs.gov.il
releases.REPORT_PDF_URL: text: link to the written report (PDF)
